description: Keeps a self-check's result in the person's free My CEM account, under Saved results, so they can see it again and take it again. Only when the person asks to keep it. Signed in, it is saved at once; otherwise the answer is a one-use link (24 hours) for them to sign in or sign up, then it is saved. The result is the check's own (calculator_get with the same answers shows it first).

answers.description: The same answers given to calculator_get

picked.description: ground-check only: the state the person chose themselves after "That's not me"

name: check_keep
title: Keep a check result in My CEM
